behaviour.text:
Photo decisions (product owner, 2026-11-18 — PRD §6.5)

• Photos only, up to 4 per post. Video comes later.
• Good deeds are shared proudly: photos are shown as taken. Nothing is blurred automatically.
• No consent tick for now (PO, 2026-11-18). Who uploaded each photo, and when, is recorded.
• Blur is optional: only if someone would rather not be shown, the reporter drags a blur over that face, or removes the photo.
• Anyone can report a photo — members, and visitors on a shared link. A report never hides the photo: it stays up until an admin decides.
• Reports about children and serious privacy concerns are reviewed first. Only an admin can remove or restore a photo. Every decision needs a note and is audit-logged.
• The uploader is told the outcome on the deed in My deeds (proper notifications come in M6). They are not told about open reports, or who reported.
• A photo report never changes the deed, its verification, counts or points.

Press Play and switch the prototype bar between Priya (reporter), Rahul (viewer) and Admin. Admin decisions show up in Priya's My deeds.
